## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(summarytools)
library(ggplot2)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(smplot2)
library(sjlabelled)
library(labelled)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(ggdist)
library(consort)
library(cardx)
library(cowplot)

```

## LOAD DATASETS

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## Load complete analytic dataset (HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset) from 01_DataManage_Exclusion.qmd file
complete_subset <- readRDS("NewData/HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset20261601.RDS")
dim(complete_subset)


## Load full data set from 01_Exclusion.qmd file
full_ele <- readRDS("NewData/full_filtered20261601.RDS")
dim(full_ele)

```

## BIVARIATE TABLES (TABLE 1)

```{r}

## Get bivariate table using the complete filtered df from above (only complete/included sample)
  ## Save variable labels into data frame for table
variable_labels <- get_label(complete_subset)
  ## Child smoking
bivar_chsmk <- complete_subset %>% 
  tbl_summary(by = CHSMOKE_R, #BY: childhood smoking
              set_gtsummary_theme(list("tbl_summary-fn:percent_fun" = function(x) sprintf(x * 100, fmt='%#.1f'))),
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                     all_continuous2() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                     all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 1),
              include = c("GRIM_residuals",  "MPOA_residuals",  "LEVINE_residuals",  "HORVATH_residuals",  "HANNUM_residuals",  "globalmethylation", "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD4", "CD8", "MO", "childrural_democoggen", "SCHLYRS", "LIVEGPAR_R", "CHSMOKE_R", "age", "sex", "race.ethnicity", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "BEALE_latest", "Parent_Educ", "ATOTB_latest", "smoke_latest", "ds_latest"),
              type = list(age ~ 'continuous', 
                          GR ~ 'continuous',
                          NK ~ 'continuous',
                          B ~ 'continuous',
                          CD4 ~ 'continuous',
                          CD8 ~ 'continuous',
                          MO ~ 'continuous',
                          HORVATH_residuals ~ 'continuous',
                          HANNUM_residuals ~ 'continuous',
                          GRIM_residuals ~ 'continuous',
                          LEVINE_residuals ~ 'continuous',
                          MPOA_residuals ~ 'continuous',
                          sex ~ 'categorical',
                          race.ethnicity ~ 'categorical',
                          globalmethylation ~ 'continuous',
                          Island_mean ~ 'continuous',
                          OpenSea_mean ~ 'continuous',
                          Shelf_mean ~ 'continuous',
                          Shore_mean ~ 'continuous',
                          SCHLYRS ~ 'continuous',
                          childrural_democoggen ~ 'categorical',
                          #CHSMOKE_R ~ 'categorical',
                          LIVEGPAR_R ~ 'categorical',
                          BEALE_latest ~ 'categorical',
                          smoke_latest ~ 'categorical',
                          ds_latest ~ 'categorical',
                          HIBP_latest ~ 'categorical',
                          DIAB_latest ~ 'categorical',
                          VIGACT_collapsed ~ 'categorical',
                          Parent_Educ ~ 'categorical',
                          ATOTB_latest ~ 'continuous2'), 
              label = as.list(variable_labels),
              missing_text = "Missing" 
  ) 
  ## Insert headers at the correct positions manually
bivar_chsmk <- bivar_chsmk %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      add_row(variable = "Phenotypic age DNAm Measures", row_type = "label", label = "Phenotypic age DNAm measures (years)",
              .before = which(.$variable == "GRIM_residuals")[1]) %>%
      add_row(variable = "Chronologic age DNAm Measures", row_type = "label", label = "Chronologic age DNAm measures (years)",
              .before = which(.$variable == "HORVATH_residuals")[1]) %>%
      add_row(variable = "Methylation by molecular location", row_type = "label", label = "Methylation by molecular location (mean (percent))",
              .before = which(.$variable == "globalmethylation")[1]) %>%
      add_row(variable = "Cell Composition", row_type = "label", label = "Cell composition (percent)",
              .before = which(.$variable == "GR")[1]) %>%
      add_row(variable = "Early Life Exposures", row_type = "label", label = "Early life exposures",
              .before = which(.$variable == "childrural_democoggen")[1]) %>%
      add_row(variable = "Participant Key Covariates", row_type = "label", label = "Participant key covariates",
              .before = which(.$variable == "age")[1]) %>%
      add_row(variable = "Adult Variables", row_type = "label", label = "Health, socioeconomic, and behavior variables",
              .before = which(.$variable == "HIBP_latest")[1])
  ) %>% bold_labels() 
  ## Indent variables
bivar_chsmk <- bivar_chsmk %>%
  modify_column_indent(columns = "label", rows = variable %in% c(
    "LEVINE_residuals",  "GRIM_residuals", 
    "MPOA_residuals",  "HORVATH_residuals", 
    "HANNUM_residuals",  "globalmethylation",
    "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean",
    "GR", "NK", "B", "CD4",
    "CD8", "MO", "SCHLYRS", "childrural_democoggen",
    "CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", 
    "age", "sex", "race.ethnicity", "ds_latest", "smoke_latest",
    "BEALE_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed",
    "ATOTB_latest", "Parent_Educ"), indent = 5) %>%
  ## Double indent specific rows
  modify_column_indent(columns = "label", rows = variable %in% c(
    "childrural_democoggen", "CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R",
    "sex", "race.ethnicity", "ds_latest", "smoke_latest",
    "BEALE_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed",
    "Parent_Educ") & row_type == "level", indent = 6)

      add_row(variable = "Adult Variables", row_type = "label", label = "Health, socioeconomic, and behavior variables",
              .before = which(.$variable == "HIBP_latest")[1])
  ) %>% bold_labels() 
  ## Indent variables

  modify_column_indent(columns = "label", rows = variable %in% c(
    "LEVINE_residuals",  "GRIM_residuals", 
    "MPOA_residuals",  "HORVATH_residuals", 
    "HANNUM_residuals",  "globalmethylation",
    "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean",
    "GR", "NK", "B", "CD4",
    "CD8", "MO", "SCHLYRS", "childrural_democoggen",
    "CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R",
    "age", "sex", "race.ethnicity", "ds_latest", "smoke_latest",
    "BEALE_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed",
    "ATOTB_latest", "Parent_Educ"), indent = 5) %>%
  # Double indent specific rows
  modify_column_indent(columns = "label", rows = variable %in% c(
    "childrural_democoggen", "CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R",
    "sex", "race.ethnicity", "ds_latest", "smoke_latest",
    "BEALE_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed",
    "Parent_Educ") & row_type == "level", indent = 6) 


## MERGE BIVARIATE TABLES (GrimAge and four primary early life exposures)

  tbls = list(bivar_childrural, bivar_schlyrs, bivar_livegpar, bivar_chsmk, bivar_grim),
```

## EXCLUSION FLOWCHART (FIGURE 1)

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

## Using the consort package
  ## https://github.com/adayim/consort
  ## Set criteria for excluding Invalid DNAm Methylation 
data_flow2 <- full_ele %>% #original dataset from which everything is excluded
  dplyr::mutate(ex1 = case_when( #variable - conditions for which to exclude - ORDER MATTERS
    (exclude == "TRUE") ~ "Missing Valid DNA Methylation Data",
    is.na(HORVATH_residuals) ~ "Missing Horvath Age Acceleration",
    is.na(HANNUM_residuals) ~ "Missing Hannum Age Acceleration",
    is.na(LEVINE_residuals) ~ "Missing Levine Age Acceleration",
    is.na(GRIM_residuals) ~ "Missing GRIMAge Acceleration",
    is.na(MPOA_residuals) ~ "Missing MPOA Age Acceleration",
    is.na(globalmethylation) ~ "Missing Global Methylation",
    is.na(Island_mean) ~ "Missing Island Methylation",
    is.na(OpenSea_mean) ~ "Missing Open Sea Methylation",
    is.na(Shelf_mean) ~ "Missing Shelf Methylation",
    is.na(Shore_mean) ~ "Missing Shore Methylation",
    )) %>%
  ## Set criteria for excluding Early Life Exposures
  dplyr::mutate(ex2 = case_when( 
    (flag_for_exclusion == "TRUE") ~ "Discordant Response: Child Smoking & Adult Smoking",
    is.na(SCHLYRS) ~ "Years in School",
    is.na(childrural_democoggen) ~ "Grew up in a Rural Area",
    is.na(CHSMOKE_R) ~ "Smoking during childhood",
    is.na(LIVEGPAR_R) ~ "Live with a Grandparent"
    )) %>%
  ## Set criteria for excluding Key Covariates
  dplyr::mutate(ex3 = case_when( 
    is.na(age) ~ "Missing age",
    is.na(sex) ~ "Missing Sex",   
    is.na(race.ethnicity) ~ "Missing Race/Ethnicity",  
    )) %>%
  ## Set criteria for excluding Health, socioeconomic, and behavior Variables
  dplyr::mutate(ex4 = case_when( 
    is.na(BEALE_latest) ~ "Urban-Rural Status",
    is.na(ds_latest) ~ "Drinking Status",
    is.na(smoke_latest) ~ "Smoking Status",
    is.na(HIBP_latest) ~ "Ever had High Blood Pressure",
    is.na(DIAB_latest) ~ "Ever had Diabetes",
    is.na(VIGACT_collapsed) ~ "Vigorous Physical Activity",
    is.na(ATOTB_latest) ~ "Total of All (Household) Assests",
    is.na(Parent_Educ) ~ "Parent Education",
    ))
  ##Set up the order of boxes for diagram
orders = c(HHIDPN = "Total Participants: Valid 2016 VBS",   #ID used to calculate total number of observations
           ex1 = "Total Missing",      #variable created above for exclusion criteria
           HHIDPN = "Valid DNA Methylation Data",      #using ID to calculate number remaining after exclusion above
           ex2 = "Total Missing",
           HHIDPN = "Participants with Complete Early Life Exposures",
           ex3 = "Total Missing",
           HHIDPN = "Participants with Complete Demographics",
           ex4 = "Total Missing",
           HHIDPN = "Final Sample")

  ## Define which boxes should be off to the side based on above orders
side_box = c("ex1", "ex2", "ex3", "ex4")

  ## Create consort diagram 
consort1 <- consort::consort_plot(data_flow2, ## data created above
                                  orders = orders, ## order of boxes
                                  side_box = side_box) ## which off to the side
consort1

```

## RAINCLOUD PLOT (FIGURE 2)

```{r, fig.width=19, fig.height=13}
## Raincloud Plots 
  ## Code adjusted based on: https://rpubs.com/rana2hin/raincloud
  ## Select variables of interest for plotting
aim1_ele3 <- complete_subset %>%
  select(GRIM_residuals,
         childrural_democoggen,
         SCHLYRS_cat,
         LIVEGPAR_R,
         CHSMOKE_R,
        ) 

## Calculate the mean of the continuous variable
mean_value <- mean(aim1_ele3$GRIM_residuals)
  

## Create plots 
plot1 <- ggplot(aim1_ele3, aes(x = childrural_democoggen, y = GRIM_residuals, fill = childrural_democoggen)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, position=position_dodge(width = 10)) +
  stat_dots(side = "left", justification = 1.1, binwidth = NA, position=position_dodge(width = 10), color = "transparent", shape=21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_value, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = 0.5, width = 0.4, justification = -0.35, .width = 0, scale = 0.5, point_colour = NA, position=position_dodge(width = 10)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text=element_text(size=18), axis.title=element_text(size=22,face="bold")) +
  labs(x = "Grew up in a rural area", y = "GrimAge DNA methylation age acceleration (years)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "darkblue", "No" = "darkred")) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "darkblue", "No" = "darkred")) +
  coord_flip()

  labs(x = "Live with a grandparent", y = "GrimAge DNA methylation age acceleration (years)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "darkblue", "No" = "darkred")) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "darkblue", "No" = "darkred")) +

plot3 <- ggplot(aim1_ele3, aes(x = CHSMOKE_R, y = GRIM_residuals, fill = CHSMOKE_R)) +

plot4 <- ggplot(aim1_ele3, aes(x = SCHLYRS_cat, y = GRIM_residuals, fill = SCHLYRS_cat)) +
```

## CORRELATION PLOT (SUPPLEMENTAL FIGURE 2)

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

#Code From: https://github.com/bakulskilab/Depressive-DNAm-Acceleration/blob/main
#Set correlation values for continuous variables keeping labels
aim1_elecorr <- select(complete_subset, "GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals", "age", "globalmethylation", "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD4", "CD8", "MO", "SCHLYRS", "ATOTB_latest")
res <- cor(aim1_elecorr, method = "pearson")
labels <- get_label(aim1_elecorr)

rownames(res) <- labels
colnames(res) <- labels 

# Plot the correlations with ggcorrplot
corplot <- ggcorrplot(res, type = "lower", outline.col = "white", digits = 2, lab = TRUE, lab_col = "black", lab_size = 1.8, tl.cex = 9.5, show.legend = TRUE, legend.title = "Pearson Correlation Coefficient (r)")
corplot2 <- ggcorrplot(res, type = "lower", outline.col = "white", digits = 2, lab = TRUE, lab_col = "black", lab_size = 1.8, tl.cex = 9.5, show.legend = FALSE)
corplot


#Export
save_plot("Manuscript/20261601/corr_plot_202603Feb.png", corplot, base_width = 15, base_height = 6, dpi = 1200, bg = "white")
save_plot("Manuscript/20261601/corr_plot_nolegend_202603Feb.png", corplot2, base_width = 15, base_height = 6, dpi = 1200, bg = "white")

```
